meta.name: research-collaborator
meta.description: Use this skill whenever a researcher wants to test, validate, stress-test, or falsify a research idea or hypothesis — especially in AI/ML/deep learning. Trigger on phrases like "I have an idea," "would this work," "test this hypothesis," "sanity check my idea," "what's wrong with this idea," "review my results," "is this publishable," "why isn't this working," or any request to evaluate the feasibility, novelty, or correctness of a research concept.

copy.tagline: 检验研究假设的可行性与正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要快速验证研究想法或评估论文可发表性。
